name: Dirge

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: A 60-foot Emanation prevents nonexempt creatures from healing. Entry, movement into a creature, or end of turn prompts a Constitution save once per turn: 3d10 Necrotic and Prone on failure; half damage and halved Speed on success. Circle variant: at least two secondary casters each spend a level 4+ slot; duration becomes 10 minutes with Concentration. Failed saves also give 1 Exhaustion; while that Exhaustion remains, Long Rests restore neither HP nor Exhaustion. Circle casting is manual.
